title: hazard.search_hazard.response
description: Hazard dataset records returned for a single chemical lookup across ToxValDB, ToxRefDB, cancer, genetox, ADME/IVIVE, IRIS, PPRTV, or HAWC selectors.

items.description: A hazard record from the selected CompTox hazard dataset.

dtxsid.description: DSSTox substance identifier when present in the upstream payload.

source.description: Source dataset, agency, or citation label.

effect.description: Reported effect or endpoint label when applicable.

unit.description: Unit associated with the reported value.
